_meta.rule_ko: 맨 이름 「SNR」은 snr_slow_ac_db(③′) 를 뜻한다. 원장은 ③·③′·dc_ac_db 를 항상 병기한다. 어느 눈금인지 안 적힌 SNR 수치는 인용 금지.

rungs.ref: slow-time sample E[m], TOTAL power (body DC included)
coherent gain of ONE STFT frame (NOT the whole CPI)
peak SNR of the blade line on the spectrogram

capture_badges.full_waveform: G_mf = 10log10(B/PRF) applies; every PRI is correlated over the full band
capture_badges.always_on_pilot: G_mf = 0 dB; PRF is the pilot repetition rate (LTE CRS 1 kHz, 5G SSB 50 Hz)
capture_badges.pre_mf: rung 1 only; the value BEFORE any matched filtering (this is the pre-2026-08-10 number)

do_not_confuse.note: three distinct quantities; the first two are both ~37 dB by coincidence

conversion.approx_note: pre-2026-08-10 code subtracted dc_ac_db directly; error <=0.41 dB for dc_ac>=10 dB, 3.01 dB at dc_ac=0 dB

MF3.what: end-to-end: fast-time kT0F*B noise -> per-PRI correlation -> slow-time SNR

MF4.what: kT0F*B / (B/PRF) == kT0F*PRF (identity of the two formulations)

MF5.what: echo_over_noise_db(): default bit-identical; full_waveform = default + G_mf; return_terms carries BOTH (old snr_band_db, new snr_slow_db)

known_gaps: g_stft_db has no primary-literature source for a single STFT frame; it is our extrapolation of Braun eq (3.37) (2-D periodogram). Recorded as ours, not as literature.
g_mf_db assumes an ideal matched filter and a clean reference channel; the real passive chain (benchmark/passive_two_channel_md.py) loses some of it.
an ECA zero-Doppler notch removes the body DC, which would drive dc_ac_off_db toward 0 dB; unmeasured (gate G16 in docs/NOISE_AND_ROTOR_PLAN.md)
